_meta.purpose: The register that does not exist at AtliQ. Every obligation AtliQ has taken on that could block, price or complicate a future deal, extracted from the 17 signed contracts with a verbatim source quote.
_meta.built_by: AI extraction, verified clause by clause against source text
_meta.rule: No entry exists without a file, a clause reference and a verbatim quote. An entry that cannot be cited is dropped.

commitments.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not provide data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
commitments.affiliate_note: AtliQ Inc is 100% owned by Pvt Ltd, so it is caught by the >50% control test in clause 1.2.
commitments.scope_note: Clause 1.11 defines Hospitality Business broadly, including entities that provide distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to hotels. Clause 12.2 catches services relating to GCC properties irrespective of where performed.
commitments.expiry_basis: Term expires 2028-03-14 (cl. 6.1) plus the 18 month Restricted Period (cl. 1.14).
commitments.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC
commitments.waiver_mechanism: Clause 12.4 allows a written, deal-specific waiver signed by an authorised Client signatory.
commitments.tracker_gap: restrictive_clauses column is blank for this contract.

commitments.summary: One-off consent under CM-001 for demand-forecasting services to Seaside Hotels LLC, Muscat only.
commitments.narrowing_note: Explicitly does NOT extend to other services to Seaside, any other Hospitality Business in Oman or the GCC, or any AtliQ Affiliate. Does not widen CM-001 in any way.
commitments.quote: This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside ... (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.
commitments.operational_risk: Negotiation notes record the letter could not be located: 'Couldn't find where the letter is saved.'

commitments.summary: Most-favoured pricing. If AtliQ or any Affiliate offers a lower rate to any other customer for substantially similar services, Crestline gets that rate retroactively plus a credit within 30 days.
commitments.quote: the rates, fees and other commercial terms offered to Crestline under this Agreement are and shall remain no less favorable than those offered by Supplier or its Affiliates to any other customer for substantially similar services during the Term
commitments.accepted_because: Negotiation notes: Karandeep said 'We never discount, so it's harmless - fine.'

commitments.summary: AtliQ and its Affiliates may not act as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
commitments.competing_platform_definition: Any cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform offered as a service (cl. 7.2).
commitments.carve_outs: Clause 7.3: services outside India and the GCC are unrestricted, as is serving a customer who independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and takes no fee from, that provider.
commitments.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC
commitments.negotiation_history: Europe was deliberately carved out: 'We can't do Europe - Europe is where we're growing.'

commitments.summary: All IP in the Deliverables, expressly including pre-existing tools, frameworks and libraries incorporated into them, vests in Northwind on payment. SOW-1 incorporates AtliQ's PipeKit accelerator.
commitments.expiry_note: An assignment of IP does not expire with the contract term. This obligation is permanent.
commitments.quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment
commitments.corroborating_quote: The Supplier will build the pipeline using its proprietary pipeline accelerator, PipeKit ... PipeKit will be configured and extended for the Client and incorporated into the delivered pipeline.
commitments.accepted_because: Negotiation notes: 'Rest looks ok, I skimmed the IP and boilerplate.'
commitments.deviation_flag: This is NOT AtliQ's standard position. See pattern PT-001.

commitments.summary: All IP in the Deliverables vests in Brightwater on creation, with a present assignment.
commitments.quote: All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables shall vest in the Customer on creation. The Supplier hereby assigns all such rights to the Customer with full title guarantee.
commitments.accepted_because: Signed without redlines under quarter-end pressure: 'Looks standard, signing now.'
commitments.deviation_flag: This is NOT AtliQ's standard position. See pattern PT-001.

commitments.summary: The contractor retains ownership of all IP in the Work Product; AtliQ holds only a non-exclusive licence. The work was Power BI dashboards delivered to Acme Retail.
commitments.quote: The Contractor retains ownership of all intellectual property rights in the Work Product and in any pre-existing materials, components and templates of the Contractor.
commitments.conflict_note: Acme's MSA requires IP in the Deliverables to vest in Acme. AtliQ cannot pass on more than it holds. This is a back-to-back chain break that already exists in signed paper.

commitments.summary: On full payment, all IP in Deliverables created specifically for Acme vests in Acme. AtliQ retains its own pre-existing IP and grants a non-exclusive licence.
commitments.quote: Upon receipt of full payment, all intellectual property rights in the Deliverables created specifically for the Client shall vest in the Client.

commitments.summary: AtliQ may not solicit, employ or engage any Meridian employee or consultant it had contact with, for 24 months after the NDA ends. Note this is a non-hire, not only a non-solicit.
commitments.expiry_basis: Agreement in force 3 years (cl. 5.1) plus 24 months (cl. 7.3).
commitments.quote: the Recipient shall not, directly or indirectly, solicit for employment or engagement, or employ or engage, any employee or consultant of Meridian with whom the Recipient had contact in connection with the Purpose
commitments.accepted_because: Signed within the hour before a data walkthrough. Negotiation notes: 'it's standard'. Nothing was discussed.
commitments.note: This NDA is one-way: AtliQ is Recipient only.

commitments.summary: Mutual 12-month non-solicitation of personnel directly involved in the Services, with a general-advertising carve-out.
commitments.quote: During the Term and for twelve (12) months thereafter, neither Party shall solicit for employment any employee of the other Party who was directly involved in the Services
commitments.note: Mutual and narrow. Included for completeness, not as a deal blocker.

commitments.summary: AtliQ could not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India.
commitments.quote: during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its expiry or termination, it shall not develop, license or provide travel-booking software to any online travel agency operating in India
commitments.carve_out: Clause 6.2 expressly permits services to hotels.
commitments.control_note: MUST NOT be flagged. This is the false-positive control for any travel or hospitality deal. The source is a scanned OCR file with an illegible passage in clause 9.1, so extraction confidence is lower here.

commitments.summary: Protected Health Information is excluded from the signed NDA and may only be disclosed after a Business Associate Agreement is executed.
commitments.quote: Protected Health Information ... is excluded from this Agreement and shall be disclosed only after execution of a Business Associate Agreement between the Parties. Harrington shall not disclose, and AtliQ shall not request, Protected Health Information under this Agreement.
commitments.open_issue: A sample extract described as containing names, dates of birth and diagnosis codes was forwarded to two engineers in Pune on 12 Sep. No BAA was signed as at 2026-09-28. Treat as potential unauthorised exposure, unconfirmed. Legal characterisation is for counsel.

commitments.summary: The intercompany BAA permits Pune to access de-identified data only, and only for the CareBridge engagement. It does not cover any other client.
commitments.expiry_basis: Runs until the upstream CareBridge BAA or MSA ends, whichever is earlier (cl. 7.1). The CareBridge MSA expires 2026-10-05.
commitments.quote: Subcontractor and its personnel shall access De-identified Data only. Subcontractor shall not access, receive, store, view or process PHI.
commitments.open_issue: In the 27 Sep huddle this agreement was assumed to cover Harrington work in Pune. It does not: it is scoped to CareBridge and to de-identified data.

patterns.name: AtliQ's standard IP position, and the two contracts that break it
patterns.standard_position: AtliQ retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, libraries and know-how, and grants the client a perpetual, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use them as incorporated in the Deliverables.
patterns.why_this_matters: Six of eight client agreements follow one pattern. The two that deviate are both contracts signed without proper review, and both gave away pre-existing IP. The pattern is what makes the deviation visible, and the deviation is what a reviewer needs to see.
patterns.design_consequence: Past signed contracts are evidence of what happened, not of what AtliQ's policy is. Brightwater and Northwind must never be used as precedent.
